problems: minor: for most of the film the surface looks like matte paint rather than a glaze; it only catches a glossy highlight in the last row of the storyboard (frames 13-16)

minor: the 'double lines cut down its belly' show up as pale lines that look raised, not cut, in the 25/50/75 % frames; a second pair of horizontal lines near the foot is visible but the caption doesn't mention it

posts.critique: A clear, well-lit turntable of a single jar sitting firmly on the sand with a believable shadow, and you can see the olive colour, the belly lines and the shoulder groove the caption names. It is quiet and a little dull to watch, and the glaze reads as matte for most of the film.
